# omadafusion_wan_ports (Data Source)

The gateway's ports as listed under Internet settings, with the UUIDs that port forwarding and static routes reference.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omadafusion_wan_ports" "this" {}

output "wan_ports" {
  value = { for p in data.omadafusion_wan_ports.this.ports : p.name => p.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `site` (String) Site name or ID.

### Read-Only

- `ports` (Attributes List) Gateway ports. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ports))

<a id="nestedatt--ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ports`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Port UUID.
- `ipv4_address` (String) Current IPv4 address, if a WAN.
- `is_wan` (Boolean) Whether the port is currently a WAN.
- `name` (String) Port name, e.g. `WAN1`.
- `online` (Boolean) Whether the WAN is online.
- `port` (Number) Physical port number.
